# Version 4.153.0
> **Skia m153 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews Skia m153 with the latest upstream renderer fixes. Linux applications relying on fontconfig fallback should review the updated fallback-face selection before adopting this preview.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback may select a different face** — Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change selected glyphs or text metrics. Specify an explicit family and style, or bundle a typeface, when deterministic font selection matters.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m153** — Moves the bundled renderer to the m153 upstream line and includes the subsequent Chrome m153 bug-fix sync. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.

## Preview 1 (September 3, 2026)

Preview 1 opens the 4.153 line with Skia m153 and its latest upstream fixes, including updated Linux font fallback behavior.
